- **Anything else:** the shared North cheat sheet lists **Thea Ramaswell** (Director of Yard Operations) as Quarrendon's main contact. Thea is also the customer contact Dana worked with during the Sev 1 outage at the Superior terminal, logged in #inc-qfl-sev1, which Ilse belongs to. On our side, **Dana Okafor** is the account manager.
- **No phone numbers:** I couldn't find a number for Bram or Thea anywhere Ilse can see. I told her to get them from her own contacts or from Dana.

Bram's name came from Ilse's own DM, so I kept it to this conversation and didn't post or mention it anywhere else. Nothing here needed approval.
